events.title: The Spring 2025 semester begins January 13 and ends May 9.
■ January 23 is the last day to withdraw and get a refund.
■ May 6 is the last day to withdraw from the course without receiving a letter g
■ The comprehensive final exam is Wednesday, May 7, from 2:00 to 3:50 pm.
■ No late work will be accepted after May 9.
